messages:
Nisha (docs): Heads up: PR 4901 (docs) failed the docs pipeline. Two separate issues in console/observability examples: dashboard sample uses wrong unit for cost and tracehook example still references old SDK param. Need fast followups.
Theo (eng-runtime): Can you paste the CI error and the snippets?
Nisha (docs): CI excerpt:
ci-bot: docs-build: FAILED docs/console/observability/examples/llm_dashboard.yaml:12 Invalid unit 'tokens'
link-checker-bot: 1 broken link found in docs/console/observability/tracehook.md -> ../playground/old-example.md

Failing dashboard snippet:
```yaml
widgets:
  - type: line
    metrics:
      - name: request_latency
        unit: ms
      - name: cost_per_request
        unit: tokens  # should be usd/token
```
Tracehook snippet in tracehook.md:
```js
// old SDK usage
client.startTrace({ trace_key: 'abc123' })
```
Theo (eng-runtime): Thanks. I'll grep the repo for `unit: tokens` and `trace_key`.
Ravi (eng-platform): I'll add a docs-lint rule to reject unknown units (PR 4902). Small change, should be quick.
Theo (eng-runtime): Grep results: 2 hits for `unit: tokens` (console examples), 1 hit in playground. 1 hit for `trace_key` in tracehook.md. I'll open PR 4903 to fix the three examples and update the JS sample to `client.startTrace({ traceId: 'abc123' })` and add an inline note about SDK param rename.
Jorge (product): Will this affect customers? Any user-facing behavior?
Nisha (docs): No runtime change, only docs samples/labels. But want to be careful about redirects for playground link so we don't 404 older crosslinks.
link-checker-bot: Suggestion: replace relative link with /playground/quickstart and add redirect from old path.
Ravi (eng-platform): I'll include the redirect in the linter PR (4902) as a follow-up commit, or we can put a tiny redirect file in the docs site config.
deploy-bot: Staging preview for #4902 + #4903 available: https://deploy-preview-4903--docs.redwood.ai/console/observability/examples/llm_dashboard.html :white_check_mark:
Nisha (docs): Quick checklist before merge: 1) change unit to `usd/token` (or `usd/request`) 2) update tracehook param and note SDK change 3) fix broken link + redirect 4) small changelog entry.
Theo (eng-runtime): PRs opened and linked to 4901: #4902 (linter + redirect), #4903 (sample fixes). CI green on both.
ci-bot: docs-build: success for PRs #4902, #4903. Netlify preview ok.
Nisha (docs): Merged all three. I'll do a lightweight link sweep and add a short note in the next docs patch release. Closing thread. :tada:
